item.title: Hopkinsville Invites Community to March, Reflect on MLK Day
item.description: Sollars Elementary School students and members of the community march to honor and celebrate Martin Luther King Jr. at Misawa Air Base, Japan, January 24, 2024. Sollars ES hosted the event to teach students the history of the civil rights movement. (U.S. Air Force photo by Staff Sgt. Kristine Legate)
